Hi Samantha — great to hear the demo landed well. Short answers up front, then I’ll loop in product for precise language we can include in the SOW:

- Fractional tokens: we meter at token granularity but bill in a pricing quantum. By default the quantum is 1 token for per-token SKUs (so fractional token rounding is effectively up to the tokenizer), and 100-token quantum for streaming/preview SKUs in pilot packages.

- Context apportionment: KV reuse is applied where the same model instance/route serves repeated requests and we detect prefix reuse within the billing window. If you stitch a long 40k history across multiple independent calls that create distinct prefixes, each call will be billed for the input tokens unless you enable prefix caching (which we recommend for agent-style stitching).

- Micro-flooring: we do have a configurable micro-floor for burst protection on reserved/pilot SKUs. Standard hosted customers see a 1-token quantum; pilot customers (like your use-case) can opt into a 100-token floor with a concession on the price per-token. I’ll attach a sample invoice mapping for three traffic scenarios.

Assigning notes from infra/product: I checked with infra and billing — current behavior:

- Token quantum: default per-token SKU quantum = 1 token (so we bill exact tokens post-tokenizer rounding). For streaming preview SKUs and reserved microfloor pilots we have an override quantum field that is configurable per-deal; in practice we set that to 100 tokens for microfloor pilots. This field is stored in the billing SKU config and surfaces on invoices as "Applied Quantum" next to usage lines.

- KV reuse/apportionment: billing applies a KV reuse credit when the same prefix hash is seen within a 24-hour billing cadence AND the request is routed to the same model variant in the same region. Stitching that results in different prefix hashes (client-side concatenation with changing metadata) will not be auto-credited. We can enable prefix-caching integration for your SDK to preserve prefix hashes across calls (engineering lift: small, config-only).

- Micro-flooring concession: finance is okay to pilot a 100-token floor with a 15% per-token discount for a 60-day POC, subject to an overage clause (if 95th percentile usage > 10x expected we revert to standard per-token billing). We will draft language for the SOW.

I’ll write the one-paragraph description and share the invoice mapping sheet.
